Hi Maria / Daniel —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we all have the same view and clear next steps: 

- Primary use case: real-time clinical-note summarization and retrieval for care teams (volume: ~12M tokens/day across pilot clinics).
- Key requirements: sub-200ms p50 generation for short summaries, on-prem option for PHI at scale, audit logs + retention policy (30/90/365 options).
- Constraints: procurement needs SOC 2 + vendor data retention answers; engineering wants a short validation plan and perf baseline.

Proposed next steps (suggested owners & timing):
1) I’ll share a brief draft commercial plan + pilot scope (attached). — Owner: me — ETA: EOW 9/22.
2) Monica (cc’d) will follow up with a SOC 2 + data handling Q&A doc tomorrow for procurement to review. — Owner: Monica — ETA: 9/19.
3) Engineering perf checkpoint: we can run a 2-week perf pass on a representative sample once we have access to a sanitized dataset. — Owner: Daniel/BluePeak — ETA: decision on access by 9/26 to keep EoQ momentum.

Attachment: proposal-draft-BluePeak-20250918.pdf (commercial + pilot scope, draft)

Question for you: is EoQ approval still something you want to push for (we’ve seen other customers prioritize approvals in the last two weeks) or should we aim for early October? Knowing that will help me propose the right commercial cadence.

If helpful, I can block 30 minutes next week to walk procurement + engineering through the pilot plan.

Best,
